## Release Notes

## Walkthrough

This PR upgrades Gray Paper version support from 0.6.7/0.7.2-preview to stable 0.7.2. It removes the `V0_6_7` enum variant, updates `DEFAULT_VERSION` to `GpVersion.V0_7_2`, and eliminates version-conditional codec logic across block encoding, work packages/reports, and state serialization. Legacy test data files (test-block-0-6-5.ts, safrole-seal-067.test.ts) are deleted, CI workflows for 0.6.7 are removed, and version-gated branches in tests are replaced with fixed expectations. The changes consolidate previously branching encoding paths into single, unified codec definitions.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes

- **Codec field ordering verification**: Ensure field reordering in work-item.ts, work-package.ts, and work-report.ts is consistent and correctly unified
- **Version enum and DEFAULT_VERSION impacts**: Verify all references to removed `V0_6_7` are cleaned up and DEFAULT_VERSION propagates correctly
- **Test expectation updates**: Validate updated hash values, state roots, and expected results align with 0.7.2 specification
- **Workflow completeness**: Confirm all 0.6.7-specific and preview workflows are fully removed without orphaned references
- **Header codec unification**: Verify header.ts and header.test.ts codec simplification maintains correct field semantics

## Possibly related PRs

- **FluffyLabs/typeberry#607**: Overlapping cleanup of pre-0.6.7 compatibility branches, legacy file removal, and version-gated logic
- **FluffyLabs/typeberry#579**: Directly touches same codec implementations (work-item.ts, work-package.ts, work-report.ts) with field reordering and version-gated encoding changes
- **FluffyLabs/typeberry#587**: Performs identical migration pattern across workflows, enums, codecs, and tests to remove older GP_VERSION values
